subject: Request: provisional GPU hold for Xavier Robotics dedicated pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: provisional GPU hold for Xavier Robotics dedicated pilot

Team,

Xavier (Ethan Cho) is in late-stage legal + procurement — they want a dedicated pilot with predictable latency and a short SLA. Sales has an internal proposal to reserve capacity while we finalize SOW/signature.

Ask: can infra confirm available pool and place a provisional hold for the pilot?
- Requested sizing (ballpark): 4x A100 80GB for model serving (8-16k tokens, 60 qps peak), plus 2x T4 for preprocessing and embeddings.
- Pilot window: 30 days, start target ~Mar 1; signature expected within 10 business days.

I attached a quick capacity request and the draft SOW.

Attachments: capacity_request_20260212.xlsx, SOW_draft_Xavier_v1.docx

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional GPU hold for Xavier Robotics dedicated pilot

On 2026-02-12 09:12, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Xavier (Ethan Cho) is in late-stage legal + procurement — they want a dedicated pilot with predictable latency and a short SLA. Sales has an internal proposal to reserve capacity while we finalize SOW/signature.

Thanks for the heads up. I'll run an inventory check against reserved and unreserved pools. Two quick Qs to size the hold precisely:
1) Is the 60 qps peak per region or global?
2) Expected average sequence length during pilot (8k-16k is a wide band) — can you confirm a 95th percentile?

If you can send a short load profile I can give a conservative node estimate. I'll try to get an initial availability check by EOD and flag any conflicts.

- Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-12T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional GPU hold for Xavier Robotics dedicated pilot

Dev — thanks. Answers below, and I'm pasting the load profile snippet for reference.
- Peak 60 qps = global peak for their US region (APAC not in scope for pilot).
- 95th percentile seq length ~12k tokens (they'll mostly use long-form code-gen + multi-turn assistant).
- Expected concurrency profile: short bursts to 60 qps for ~10-15 min every hour; steady-state 20-25 qps.

Sizing notes: use conservative perf numbers — model is a 30B dense variant, quantized to BF16. We want headroom for KV cache and warmup.

Soft vs hard hold: Sales prefers a 2-week soft hold (can't be taken by new long-term reserved deals without approval) and then convert to hard commit once PO/SOW is signed. If infra needs a different policy, say so.

Also attaching the capacity_request_20260212.xlsx with the load profile and SOW draft.

Karthik
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-13T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional GPU hold for Xavier Robotics dedicated pilot

Morning — ran a quick perf calc and recommendation below (high-level):

Recommendation (pilot):
- Reserve 6 x A100 80GB nodes in the US region; target 4 primary for serving and 2 spare for headroom and KV-cache warmups.
- Reserve 2 x T4 nodes for preprocessing/embeddings (burstable).
- Expected utilization: 60 qps peaks handled by 4 nodes with batching and small-prefix caching; spares cover rollouts and retries.

Hold policy suggestion:
- Place a 14-day provisional hold (soft) in the capacity tracker. After 14 days, if no signature/PO, auto-release unless sales asks to extend. On signature, convert hold to a committed allocation and notify billing/ops.

I've attached a short rationale doc with the perf numbers (proposed_sizing_rationale.pdf). If infra/ops are good with the hold window, I can update the mutual action plan and inform Xavier.

Marcus Lin
Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_sizing_rationale.pdf
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-13T15:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional GPU hold for Xavier Robotics dedicated pilot

Thanks all — did the inventory sweep and placed a provisional hold per Marcus' recommendation. Details:
- Hold ID: CH-789
- Resources reserved: 6 x A100-80GB, 2 x T4 (US-west pool)
- Hold type: soft (14-day window)
- Deadline to convert: 2026-02-26T23:59:00-08:00 (auto-release after deadline)

Internal ticket: https://internal.redwood.ai/capacity/holds/CH-789
HubSpot deal linked: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

If sales gets signed docs before the deadline, reply-all with the PO/SOW and we'll convert the hold to committed. If anything changes (scope/date/region), flag immediately.

- Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
